The '''Jovaria system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Lemmi system/Legends|Lemmi]], [[Selab system/Legends|Selab]], and [[Thrakia system/Legends|Thrakia systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Jovaria [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] known as the [[Jovarian sun fern]].<ref name="Galladinium" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jovaria system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
